cases.name: etaf-export-registers-with-etaf-ext-and-exposes-minimal-commands
cases.purpose: etaf-export registers cleanly with etaf-ext, exposes only the three core interactive commands (etaf-export, etaf-export-pdf, etaf-export-svg) and three C-c C-e x dispatch bindings, opens its compact manager popup, and reports rsvg-convert status via etaf-export-doctor.

cases.name: etaf-export-live-preview-workspace-navigates-and-updates-options
cases.purpose: M-x etaf-export opens the live export preview workspace preserving the mode-line, supports page navigation, theme toggling, page-mode cycling and dismissal via keyboard commands, and excludes itself from etaf-export matching.

cases.name: etaf-export-svg-and-pdf-paginated-a4-single-and-light-remap
cases.purpose: etaf-export exports a mounted multi-section dark ETAF page to multi-page A4 PDF, continuous single-page PDF, and light-remapped white-paper SVG/PDF without mutating the live buffer.

cases.name: etaf-export-aligns-unsliced-svg-icons-and-preserves-currentcolor-and-tabs
cases.purpose: etaf-export measures unsliced inline SVG icons (such as etaf-ui-icon without :width/:height plist keys) at their true intrinsic dimensions, keeps card borders pixel-aligned across rows, centers icons vertically, inherits face foreground for currentColor, and expands tabs.

cases.name: etaf-export-embeds-vector-svg-with-scoped-ids-and-raster-images
cases.purpose: etaf-export embeds inline vector SVG graphics with scoped fragment IDs (avoiding rasterization), remaps named SVG colors in light mode, clamps wide diagrams to preserve body scale, and produces a valid vector PDF.

cases.name: etaf-export-signals-structured-errors-for-invalid-inputs
cases.purpose: etaf-export-pdf and etaf-export-svg reject empty/nil batch paths, invalid page-mode, invalid theme, missing runtime or missing rsvg-convert with etaf-export-error.
